name.fr-FR: Opuscules de saint François de Sales, tome XXIII
name.en-US: Opuscules of St. Francis de Sales, vol. XXIII
name.pt-BR: Opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales, tomo XXIII

description.fr-FR: Les opuscules du tome XXIII de l’édition d’Annecy : les écrits de controverse (fragments sur la prédestination, brève méditation sur le Symbole, lettres au ministre Viret, fragment du livre IV de l’Estendart) et le début de l’administration épiscopale.
description.en-US: The opuscules in volume XXIII of the Annecy edition: the controversy writings (fragments on predestination, the brief meditation on the Creed, letters to the minister Viret, the fragment of Book IV of the Standard) and the start of the episcopal administration.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales no tomo XXIII da edição de Annecy (Troisième et quatrième séries).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. XXIII: Opuscules, 1926 (file 23), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original spelling (and the Latin or Italian of some pieces), extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references, the variants and footnotes, and the editors’ introductions and tables are not included. Chapters follow the printed section headings; short sections are folded into the preceding chapter under a second-level heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
